comment: Professor Stegmeir in general is the best professor for costume, but the actual course is more demanding than it should be. Lab hours are mandatory and can be intimidating, but the actual class is awesome if you enjoy this stuff. No homework but some projects take HOURS outside of class.

Johann is awesome. He is a great professor who wants everyone to do well. You have to pay attention at the beginning but you get the hang of it after a while. This class was a nice escape from your typical lecture and was a nice break in my day. You have some hw at the beginning with little sewing samples but it gets easier and lighter as you go

This was one of my favorite classes ever. The in-class projects were pretty time-consuming but really helped me learn how to sew, which is such a huge life skill. The class was also just a nice break from the rest of my classes because it wasn't something that I really had to think about. I highly recommend taking this class. It is a useful gen ed.
Hands on class that is a good change of pace from your typical classroom. Papers consist of blog posts which are based off of plays you watch. Would definitely recommend for art gen ed.

I highly suggest taking this class. Johann is amazing and has so many sotries tot ell from his time doing costume around the world. Clear grading and fun projects, though they do take a lot time outside of class to complete. He demos the assignments, but he moves quickly so make sure to pay attention. Very helpful and fun to talk to.

Had him for costume. The class was a breeze most of the time except for two or three big projects. You learn how to sew and he has amazing stories of his work in costume design. Not a tough grader, as long as you show him respect and attempt to come to class and complete assignments. You might pull an all-nighter on a project but it's an easy A/B.
